290: // Stop notifies the telemetry endpoint that the app is closing. All outstanding
291: // messages will also be sent. No further messages will be sent until the client
292: // is started again
293: func (c *client) Stop() {
294: 	c.mu.Lock()
295: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
296: 	if !c.started {
297: 		return
298: 	}
299: 	c.started = false

305: 		cnn := make(chan struct{})

307: 			cnn <- struct{}{}
308: 			close(cnn)
309: 		})
310: 		<-cnn
311: 	} else {
312: 		c.flush()
313: 	}
